scenes.headline: How an agent learns when to forget
scenes.sub: AutoCompact trains a coding agent to call its own compact at phase boundaries.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pogo! AutoCompact teaches a coding agent to decide for itself when to summarize and forget. Here's how.

scenes.label: The bet
scenes.text: When to compact is a decision the agent should make about its own task state, not a token count a harness enforces.
scenes.mark: a decision the agent should make

left.title: Fixed threshold
items: Summarize once tokens cross a set count
left.say: The usual fix is a clock: past a token count, everything before is summarized, whatever the agent was doing.

right.title: AutoCompact
items: Trained to fire at task-phase boundaries
right.say: AutoCompact gives the model a compact tool, and trains it to call it when a phase ends.

steps.say: When the agent calls compact, the trajectory so far is rewritten.
A generated summary replaces it: the objective, the localized issue, files touched, what's verified, and what's next.
The original task description and the most recent turns stay word for word.
Everything else goes: dead-end hypotheses, reverted edits, redundant file reads.

scenes.title: Training: a judge corrects the trajectory

items.say: At each step of a rollout, a judge model sees only the history so far.
It leaves the action, swaps in a compact call, or repairs a summary missing state.
From three hundred seventy-nine tasks, that yields one thousand and fifty-two fine-tuning examples.
Then reinforcement learning, rewarded only for passing, pushes further.

scenes.title: Tasks where the agent compacts
scenes.say: Reinforcement learning makes it compact more often: from forty-four point three percent of tasks to fifty-eight point five.

scenes.label: RL gain on SWE-bench Verified, the only exact result in the post
scenes.note: no paper, no code, no arXiv listing; the charts carry no numbers
scenes.say: The one hard number, a ten point six percent reinforcement learning gain, is stated in prose. No paper, no code.

scenes.text: A judge that corrects trajectories step by step is a cheap way to teach a decision that's hard to hand-label.

recap: Compact is a tool call, not a clock
Keep the task and recent turns; summarize the rest
A judge corrects rollouts, then RL sharpens it
scenes.say: To recap: compaction as a decision, a summary that keeps what matters, and a judge that teaches the timing.
